key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: LUNA: Hello, \PN, and welcome.
en: LUNA: Hello, \PN, and welcome.
ja: ルナ: こんにちは、\PN、ようこそ。

key: We last parted ways not far from here before,
en: We last parted ways not far from here before,
ja: 前回別れたのも、ここからそう遠くない場所でしたわね、

key: Though it looked much different then, did it not?
en: Though it looked much different then, did it not?
ja: もっとも、あの時とは随分違って見えるけれど、そうではなくて?

key: Nothing can refuse the tides of change,
en: Nothing can refuse the tides of change,
ja: 変化の潮流には、何ものも逆らえません、

key: Not even nothingness itself.
en: Not even nothingness itself.
ja: 無そのものでさえも。

key: To you, I am eternally indebted for preventing Lin from overwriting our world with this new one.
en: To you, I am eternally indebted for preventing Lin from overwriting our world with this new one.
ja: あなたには、リンがこの新しい世界でわたくしたちの世界を上書きするのを防いでいただいたこと、永遠に恩義を感じておりますわ。

key: But you must understand,
en: But you must understand,
ja: けれど、わかっていただかなくては、

key: That I am also indebted to Lin for making this dream a reality.
en: That I am also indebted to Lin for making this dream a reality.
ja: この夢を現実にしてくれたことについて、わたくしはリンにも恩義があるのです。

key: I have always said that the beauty of darkness lies in its infinite potential, have I not?
en: I have always said that the beauty of darkness lies in its infinite potential, have I not?
ja: 闇の美しさとは、その無限の可能性にこそある――いつもそう申しておりましたでしょう?

key: One never knows just what lies beyond arm's reach,
en: One never knows just what lies beyond arm's reach,
ja: 手の届かぬ先に何があるかなど、決してわからないもの、

key: Whether it is the warm embrace of a lover,
en: Whether it is the warm embrace of a lover,
ja: それが恋人の温かな抱擁なのか、

key: Or the maw of a demon.
en: Or the maw of a demon.
ja: それとも悪魔の顎門なのか。

key: Here, both exist.
en: Here, both exist.
ja: ここには、その両方が存在いたします。

key: I believe there can be no finer edge to walk.
en: I believe there can be no finer edge to walk.
ja: これほど心地よい際はないと思いますの。

key: No finer pleasure to savor...
en: No finer pleasure to savor...
ja: これほど味わい深い喜びも……

key: But I dally.
en: But I dally.
ja: けれど、話が逸れましたわね。

key: You are here for business rather than pleasure.
en: You are here for business rather than pleasure.
ja: あなたがいらしたのは、楽しみのためではなく用件のためでしょう。

key: Noel and Mother...
en: Noel and Mother...
ja: ノエルとお母様……

key: Anna, Noel and Mother...
en: Anna, Noel and Mother...
ja: アンナ、ノエルとお母様……

key: Rest assured, they are safe.
en: Rest assured, they are safe.
ja: ご安心を、みな無事ですわ。

key: Asleep, but safe.
en: Asleep, but safe.
ja: 眠ってはいますが、無事です。

key: After all, even the worst nightmare is safer than the waking world.
en: After all, even the worst nightmare is safer than the waking world.
ja: 何しろ、最悪の悪夢でさえ、目覚めた世界よりは安全なのですから。

key: Still, is it not time they rose?
en: Still, is it not time they rose?
ja: とはいえ、そろそろ起きる頃合いではなくて?

key: As ever, \PN, the way forward is yours to take.
en: As ever, \PN, the way forward is yours to take.
ja: いつも通り、\PN、進む道はあなたが選ぶものです。

key: LUNA: As ever, \PN, the way forward is yours to take.
en: LUNA: As ever, \PN, the way forward is yours to take.
ja: ルナ: いつも通り、\PN、進む道はあなたが選ぶものです。

key: LUNA: One day, this germinal world will produce visions and landscapes far surpassing any among ours.
en: LUNA: One day, this germinal world will produce visions and landscapes far surpassing any among ours.
ja: ルナ: いつの日か、この芽生えたばかりの世界は、わたくしたちのどんな世界をもしのぐ幻影と風景を生み出すことでしょう。

key: But like an artist who's only just taken to the brush, what it can create right now is rather limited.
en: But like an artist who's only just taken to the brush, what it can create right now is rather limited.
ja: けれど、筆を取ったばかりの画家のように、今この瞬間に生み出せるものはまだかなり限られていますの。

key: Over time, as it too grows with experience and history, its productions will become more and more complex,
en: Over time, as it too grows with experience and history, its productions will become more and more complex,
ja: 時が経ち、経験と歴史とともに成長するにつれ、その創造物はますます複雑になっていくでしょう、

key: With mountains as melodies and moments as motifs, each stroke it makes plays over each other as if building up to a melodious canon.
en: With mountains as melodies and moments as motifs, each stroke it makes plays over each other as if building up to a melodious canon.
ja: 山々を旋律に、瞬間を動機として、その一筆一筆が重なり合い、まるで美しいカノンを築き上げていくかのように。

key: I can only hope that I will still be around to hear its performance at its crescendo.
en: I can only hope that I will still be around to hear its performance at its crescendo.
ja: その頂点の演奏を聞くまで、わたくしがまだここにいられることをただ願うばかりですわ。

key: For now, it is no such grand thing,
en: For now, it is no such grand thing,
ja: 今のところ、そのような壮大なものではなく、

key: But more like two songs played over each other, each vying for its listener's ear.
en: But more like two songs played over each other, each vying for its listener's ear.
ja: むしろ二つの歌が重なり合って、聞き手の耳を奪い合っているようなものです。

key: You will find our world twisted together alongside it.
en: You will find our world twisted together alongside it.
ja: わたくしたちの世界も、それと絡み合っているのがわかるはずですわ。

key: In particular, it seems to have tangled up in my Master's estate.
en: In particular, it seems to have tangled up in my Master's estate.
ja: 特に、わたくしのご主人様の館に絡みついているようですの。

key: Look there.
en: Look there.
ja: あちらをご覧なさいな。

key: LUNA: It is still possible to step into our world there.
en: LUNA: It is still possible to step into our world there.
ja: ルナ: あそこからなら、まだわたくしたちの世界に足を踏み入れることができますわ。

key: Pockets of that world have been isolated behind and among this reality.
en: Pockets of that world have been isolated behind and among this reality.
ja: あの世界の断片が、この現実の裏や隙間に孤立して残っているのです。

key: It is how what should have been an ordinary trip to explore Master's castle ended up with each of them stuck in this realm.
en: It is how what should have been an ordinary trip to explore Master's castle ended up with each of them stuck in this realm.
ja: だからこそ、ご主人様の城を探索するはずだったただの旅が、それぞれこの領域に閉じ込められる結果になったのですわ。

key: But that does not mean those pockets line up to what we see perfectly.
en: But that does not mean those pockets line up to what we see perfectly.
ja: けれど、それらの断片が、目に見えるものと完全に一致するとは限りません。

key: If a door is locked, it may as well be as if nothing is behind it at all.
en: If a door is locked, it may as well be as if nothing is behind it at all.
ja: 扉に鍵がかかっているなら、その向こうには何もないも同然なのです。

key: And in this case, that is very well the truth.
en: And in this case, that is very well the truth.
ja: そして今回は、まさにそれが真実ですわ。

key: Like a lamp with no bulb, what we seek simply isn't there yet.
en: Like a lamp with no bulb, what we seek simply isn't there yet.
ja: 電球のないランプのように、わたくしたちが求めるものは、まだそこには存在していないのです。

key: LUNA: Fear not.
en: LUNA: Fear not.
ja: ルナ: ご安心を。

key: In a world as unstable as this, I have no doubt that there is a way for us to connect the dots, so to speak.
en: In a world as unstable as this, I have no doubt that there is a way for us to connect the dots, so to speak.
ja: これほど不安定な世界であれば、点と点をつなぐ方法が――いわば――きっとあるはずですわ。

key: Let us search and find what belongs behind each door, so that it may put itself into place.
en: Let us search and find what belongs behind each door, so that it may put itself into place.
ja: それぞれの扉の向こうにあるべきものを探し出して、あるべき場所へと収まるようにいたしましょう。

key: LUNA: Let us search and find what belongs behind each door, so that it may put itself into place.
en: LUNA: Let us search and find what belongs behind each door, so that it may put itself into place.
ja: ルナ: それぞれの扉の向こうにあるべきものを探し出して、あるべき場所へと収まるようにいたしましょう。

key: LUNA: With this, two ends of our worlds have been stitched to each other.
en: LUNA: With this, two ends of our worlds have been stitched to each other.
ja: ルナ: これで、わたくしたちの世界の両端が縫い合わされましたわ。

key: It is perhaps unsurprising that the needle required for such a thing would have been left about this place.
en: It is perhaps unsurprising that the needle required for such a thing would have been left about this place.
ja: そのために必要な針が、この場所に置き去りにされていたのも、意外なことではないでしょう。

key: I suspect that Lin may have intended the New World to serve as a sort of playground or toy box for her...
en: I suspect that Lin may have intended the New World to serve as a sort of playground or toy box for her...
ja: リンは、この新世界を自分の遊び場、いわばおもちゃ箱のようなものにするつもりだったのではと思いますの……

key: And what a dangerous toy that is, isn't it, able to sew worlds together?
en: And what a dangerous toy that is, isn't it, able to sew worlds together?
ja: 世界同士を縫い合わせられるなんて、なんて危険なおもちゃなのかしら?

key: It is just to her liking, I imagine.
en: It is just to her liking, I imagine.
ja: まさに彼女の好みそのものでしょうね。

key: Nevertheless, there will be others now.
en: Nevertheless, there will be others now.
ja: とはいえ、これからは他の者たちもいますわ。

key: Let us hope that they can be reached.
en: Let us hope that they can be reached.
ja: その者たちに手が届くことを願いましょう。

key: LUNA: Needles may be dangerous, but I am not of the opinion that we should withhold them from children.
en: LUNA: Needles may be dangerous, but I am not of the opinion that we should withhold them from children.
ja: ルナ: 針は危険かもしれませんが、それを子供たちから取り上げるべきだとは思いませんの。

key: After all, it is only through experience that one will learn proper care.
en: After all, it is only through experience that one will learn proper care.
ja: 何しろ、正しい扱い方を学べるのは、経験を通してだけですから。

key: LUNA: You saw Noel, did you?
en: LUNA: You saw Noel, did you?
ja: ルナ: ノエルをご覧になったのですね?

key: Worry not. I'm sure we'll be able to connect to him soon enough.
en: Worry not. I'm sure we'll be able to connect to him soon enough.
ja: ご心配なく。すぐに彼のところへつながるはずですわ。

key: LUNA: It would seem that we've arrived at our final destination here.
en: LUNA: It would seem that we've arrived at our final destination here.
ja: ルナ: どうやら、ここが最後の目的地のようですわね。

key: Fear not; the others have been safely escorted out of this place.
en: Fear not; the others have been safely escorted out of this place.
ja: ご安心を、他の方々は無事にこの場所から連れ出されていますわ。

key: Let us focus solely on the trial before us.
en: Let us focus solely on the trial before us.
ja: 目の前の試練にだけ、集中いたしましょう。

key: To that end, there is something you must be aware of.
en: To that end, there is something you must be aware of.
ja: そのために、知っておいていただきたいことがございます。

key: This Cresselia was generated here in the New World, among all of its infinities,
en: This Cresselia was generated here in the New World, among all of its infinities,
ja: このクレセリアは、無数に広がるこの新世界の中で生み出されたもの、

key: And as a result, it is the source of an Anomaly.
en: And as a result, it is the source of an Anomaly.
ja: その結果、アノマリーの発生源となっています。

key: That Anomaly is the swirling aura that encompasses Cresselia.
en: That Anomaly is the swirling aura that encompasses Cresselia.
ja: そのアノマリーとは、クレセリアを包み込む渦巻くオーラのことですわ。

key: It has the effect of attracting, strengthening, and directing other Pokémon, much like how a planet's gravity maintains its moons.
en: It has the effect of attracting, strengthening, and directing other Pokémon, much like how a planet's gravity maintains its moons.
ja: 惑星の重力が衛星を留めておくように、他のポケモンを引き寄せ、強化し、導く効果があるのです。

key: When confronting an Anomaly, please be prepared to deal with these 'moons', as well.
en: When confronting an Anomaly, please be prepared to deal with these 'moons', as well.
ja: アノマリーに立ち向かう際は、この「衛星」にも対処する心構えをしておいてくださいませ。

key: The Pokémon at the source of the Anomaly is also affected.
en: The Pokémon at the source of the Anomaly is also affected.
ja: アノマリーの発生源であるポケモン自身も、影響を受けます。

key: You may find that the Anomaly gives it extra strength, or renewed life, for instance.
en: You may find that the Anomaly gives it extra strength, or renewed life, for instance.
ja: 例えば、アノマリーによって力が増していたり、生命力が回復していたりすることがあるでしょう。

key: There is no need for alarm, however.
en: There is no need for alarm, however.
ja: けれど、恐れる必要はありませんわ。

key: Once you defeat the Anomaly, it will disappear, leaving only its source.
en: Once you defeat the Anomaly, it will disappear, leaving only its source.
ja: アノマリーを倒せば消え去り、あとには発生源だけが残ります。

key: Its source may still be healthy afterwards, but its power will be drastically reduced.
en: Its source may still be healthy afterwards, but its power will be drastically reduced.
ja: その発生源はその後も元気なままかもしれませんが、力は大きく弱まっているはずです。

key: At this point, you will be able to catch it, should you so choose to.
en: At this point, you will be able to catch it, should you so choose to.
ja: その時点で、お望みなら捕らえることができますわ。

key: Does all of that make sense?
en: Does all of that make sense?
ja: ここまでで、わかりましたか?

key: LUNA: Very good.
en: LUNA: Very good.
ja: ルナ: 結構ですわ。

key: LUNA: My apologies for the confusion.
en: LUNA: My apologies for the confusion.
ja: ルナ: 混乱させてしまい、申し訳ありません。

key: To put it in simpler terms, think of confronting these Legendary Pokémon as a two step process:
en: To put it in simpler terms, think of confronting these Legendary Pokémon as a two step process:
ja: もっと簡単に言えば、これらの伝説のポケモンとの対決は、二段階のものだとお考えください。

key: First, you will fight the Anomaly and its accompanying Pokémon, much like as if it were a Trainer.
en: First, you will fight the Anomaly and its accompanying Pokémon, much like as if it were a Trainer.
ja: まず、アノマリーとそれに付き従うポケモンと戦います。まるでトレーナー戦のように。

key: Second, you will confront the wild Legendary Pokémon directly.
en: Second, you will confront the wild Legendary Pokémon directly.
ja: 次に、野生の伝説のポケモンと直接向き合うのです。

key: But let us not dally too much further.
en: But let us not dally too much further.
ja: ですが、これ以上長話はやめておきましょう。

key: After all, it seems that Anna is waiting for us.
en: After all, it seems that Anna is waiting for us.
ja: 何しろ、アンナが待っているようですから。

key: LUNA: And it would seem she is not the only one.
en: LUNA: And it would seem she is not the only one.
ja: ルナ: それに、待っているのは彼女だけではなさそうですわね。

key: LUNA: After all, it seems that Cresselia is waiting for us.
en: LUNA: After all, it seems that Cresselia is waiting for us.
ja: ルナ: 何しろ、クレセリアも待っているようですから。

key: CRESSELIA: Liiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!
en: CRESSELIA: Liiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!
ja: クレセリア: リイイイイイイイイイイイイ!

key: Cress--?
en: Cress--?
ja: クレス……?

key: LUNA: Well met, as ever.
en: LUNA: Well met, as ever.
ja: ルナ: お久しぶりですわね、いつものように。

key: The second phase begins now.
en: The second phase begins now.
ja: 第二段階が、今始まります。

key: With the energy dispelled, its defenses are weakened.
en: With the energy dispelled, its defenses are weakened.
ja: エネルギーが払われ、防御が弱まっています。

key: If you wish to catch it, now would be the time.
en: If you wish to catch it, now would be the time.
ja: 捕まえたいなら、今がその時ですわ。

key: LUNA: It's coming back.
en: LUNA: It's coming back.
ja: ルナ: 戻ってきますわね。

key: Once more, please, \PN?
en: Once more, please, \PN?
ja: もう一度、お願いできますか、\PN?

key: CRESSELIA: Cress!!!
en: CRESSELIA: Cress!!!
ja: クレセリア: クレス!!!

key: LUNA: And so it's done.
en: LUNA: And so it's done.
ja: ルナ: これで、終わりましたわね。

key: You've handled this as expertly as expected.
en: You've handled this as expertly as expected.
ja: 予想通り、見事な手際でしたわ。

key: But I suppose there is nothing left for us here now.
en: But I suppose there is nothing left for us here now.
ja: けれど、もうここでやることは何もないようですわね。

key: The castle will not return to normal, but somehow I doubt that Master will mind the redecoration terribly much.
en: The castle will not return to normal, but somehow I doubt that Master will mind the redecoration terribly much.
ja: お城は元通りにはなりませんが、ご主人様もこの模様替えをそこまで気にはなさらないと思いますわ。

key: Meanwhile, this world has developed quickly enough that I'm afraid nothing is near this place anymore.
en: Meanwhile, this world has developed quickly enough that I'm afraid nothing is near this place anymore.
ja: 一方で、この世界はあまりにも急速に発展してしまい、もうこの場所の近くには何もないのが心配ですわ。

key: It is likely we will need to rely on other entrances to do so, but there still is a chance we will find him in this place too.
en: It is likely we will need to rely on other entrances to do so, but there still is a chance we will find him in this place too.
ja: 別の入口に頼る必要がありそうですが、それでもこの場所で彼を見つけられる可能性はまだございます。

key: To that end, I suppose I must eventually step back into the light for a spell.
en: To that end, I suppose I must eventually step back into the light for a spell.
ja: そのためには、いずれまた光の中へ戻らなくてはなりませんわね。

key: LUNA: Curious.
en: LUNA: Curious.
ja: ルナ: おかしなこと。

key: She isn't waking up like the others did?
en: She isn't waking up like the others did?
ja: 彼女は、他の皆のようには目を覚まさないのですか?

key: She is most certainly breathing...
en: She is most certainly breathing...
ja: 呼吸は確かにしていますけれど……

key: But if Cresselia wasn't what was keeping her asleep, then what could it be?
en: But if Cresselia wasn't what was keeping her asleep, then what could it be?
ja: けれど、彼女を眠らせていたのがクレセリアでなかったのなら、一体何だったのでしょう?

key: You don't suppose she's just having a sweet dream, do you?
en: You don't suppose she's just having a sweet dream, do you?
ja: まさか、ただ甘い夢を見ているだけ、ということはないでしょうね?

key: Nevertheless, I'll take responsibility to see her to safety.
en: Nevertheless, I'll take responsibility to see her to safety.
ja: いずれにせよ、彼女を無事な場所へ連れて行く責任は、わたくしが持ちますわ。

key: I am aware that I owe her for several things, after all.
en: I am aware that I owe her for several things, after all.
ja: 何しろ、彼女にはいくつも借りがありますから。

key: Ah, by the way, I found this while I was exploring the nebulae.
en: Ah, by the way, I found this while I was exploring the nebulae.
ja: ああ、そういえば、星雲を探索していたときにこれを見つけましたの。

key: Now that you've returned, I suppose you may find some use in it.
en: Now that you've returned, I suppose you may find some use in it.
ja: あなたが戻ってきたのなら、これも何かの役に立つかもしれませんわね。

key: LUNA: As always, it has been a pleasure.
en: LUNA: As always, it has been a pleasure.
ja: ルナ: いつも通り、楽しいひとときでしたわ。

key: I understand the Nightclub has been serving as a base of operations for exploring this place?
en: I understand the Nightclub has been serving as a base of operations for exploring this place?
ja: ナイトクラブが、この場所を探索する拠点として使われていると聞きましたが?

key: Would you like to accompany me there?
en: Would you like to accompany me there?
ja: そちらまで、ご一緒しませんこと?

key: LUNA: Then let us be off.
en: LUNA: Then let us be off.
ja: ルナ: では、参りましょう。

key: LUNA: Very well.
en: LUNA: Very well.
ja: ルナ: よろしいでしょう。

key: Until next our destinies cross~
en: Until next our destinies cross~
ja: また、わたくしたちの運命が交わる時まで~

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
